Title: Tech Builder Tee
Body (HTML):
Joy's tee, and Joy is the one always halfway through the next idea. The print runs on gaming energy: LEVEL UP, NEXT GEN ENERGY and OWN YOUR GAME, scattered with sticker-style doodles. LEVEL UP turns up across the back as well. Four colourways in all.

The cotton is 100% organic, the inks OEKO-TEX certified, the tee BIS certified. Sized for ages four to twelve. It handles a controller, a football and whatever gets spilled at lunch.
